positions.title: Peer Advisor
positions.description:
• Contributed to bi-weekly meetings by organizing monthly General Meetings and speaker workshops.
• Advised first generation students by holding weekly office hours for college
transition support.

positions.title: Undergraduate Research Assistant
positions.locationName: Sack and Yarov-Yarovoy Lab, Department of Physiology and Membrane Biology
positions.description:
• Used various data analyzing techniques such as data mining, visualizing 3D structure of membrane proteins, and creating energy plots for extracting and cleaning amino acid data from the Protein Data Bank (PDB).
• Refined Energy Scoring Function of Rosetta Membrane Software to understand membrane protein structure design principles for drug target insights.
• Communicated research by presenting scientific posters at seven scientific meetings throughout undergraduate education to various audiences.
positions.insights: Skills: Data Processing · Python (Programming Language) · SQL · Bioinformatics · Data Analysis · Computational Biology
